notes.title: New Updates ! Steam Trading Cards, Cloud Support and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4155602/f88a3c460e31a733504199cb6d21e8f9e1bd4418.png[/img]
As we prep for the release of [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/470210/]Rocketbirds 2 Evolution[/url], set to release in 2 days - Many of you noticed that we have Trading Cards for Rocketbirds 2, and asked if we will do an update for Rocketbirds: Hardboiled Chicken to have Trading Cards as well. As you may have guessed, we just did. So Enjoy!

[h1][b] Steam Trading Cards [/b][/h1]
[list][*] 5 New Trading cards / Wallpapers
[*] 5 Emoticons
[*] 1 Badge
[/list]

[h1][b] Cloud Support [/b][/h1]
Steam Cloud Save is now available.

[h1][b] Bug Fixes [/b][/h1]
The following bugs have been fixed on the Windows build.
[list]
    [*]Sound for movie 5 ( illuminate me ) cuts off at the beginning.
    [*] Game gets stuck in the loading screen after completing the final mission in hard difficulty.
[/list]

notes.title: Now Available - Rocketbirds: Hardboiled Chicken
notes.content:
Rocketbirds: Hardboiled Chicken is now available on Steam!

Annihilate an evil penguin regime in this cinematic platform adventure game offering full solo and co-op campaigns.

Set out on a mission to assassinate the totalitarian penguin leader as Hardboiled Chicken. Destroy enemies with a slew of weapons and illuminate the secrets to his past while uncovering the real enemies of Albatropolis. Master fowl play in the co-op campaign as a pair of Budgie commandos on a mission to save the general's daughter. Many lives will be destroyed, countless penguins will die!
